what_it_does: It grants the reader the likeness they will assume anyway, then names the one difference that stops them treating the two as the same.
when_to_use: Right where the post compares Pokemon team building with optimisation benchmarks, because an engineer who sees a team as slots of choices will assume it behaves like Pest Control.
anchor_in_draft: If you look other academic benchmark for optimization they are smooth.

candidates.sentence: A Pokemon team looks like a point on Pest Control, a standard benchmark for Bayesian optimisation: a row of slots, each set to one choice from a list. But the steps are not the same size. One Pest Control step moves the score by 0.32 to 0.37 of the spread between that benchmark's starting points. Swapping one whole Pokemon on a tournament-ready team moved its win rate by 0.65 of the spread between teams, after removing battle luck.

facts.claim: Pest Control has 25 variables with 5 categories each, a chain of pest control stations where each station takes one of 4 pesticides or none
facts.source: Oh et al. 2019, Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization using the Graph Cartesian Product, https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.00448, Supplement 4.2.2

facts.claim: One Pest Control step changes one station. Its share of the benchmark's own spread is 0.14 pooled over random and hill-climbed starting points, and 0.37 and 0.32 when each kind of starting point uses its own spread. Decided 2026-11-13: the two kinds of starting point are not pooled, so the step is 0.37 and 0.32 and the pooled 0.14 is not used.
facts.source: notes/artifacts/one-edit-away-explanation-elements/v2/FACTS.md, Reading two and Decision on the benchmark spread

facts.claim: Whole-Pokemon swap on tournament-ready teams: 5.90 win-rate points after removing battle luck, 95% interval 4.78 to 7.01, share 0.65 of the 9.04-point spread of true scores between teams, share interval 0.49 to 0.92
facts.source: notes/artifacts/one-edit-away-explanation-elements/rerun-readings.json, groups.outside_top50.kinds.F_candidate_copy, and code/docs/ruggedness2.md, Reading without the 5-point cutoff

facts.claim: The whole-Pokemon swap is larger than a Pest Control step for tournament-ready teams

Scope: each score is a win rate over 384 battles against the 50 top-placing tournament teams, the same behaviour-cloning battle policy plays both sides, slots shuffled. The swap replaces one Pokemon with a real set of a different species. 0.65 is a share of one standard deviation of team scores, not of the gap between two typical teams
facts.source: notes/artifacts/one-edit-away-explanation-elements/v2/FACTS.md, The finished measurement and Scope limits

candidates.sentence: A Pokemon team looks like a Pest Control point, a row of slots where each slot takes one choice from a list. But every one of Pest Control's 25 slots offers the same 5 choices, while on a team the species decides what the other slots may hold: Ditto can learn one move and Gallade can learn 105.

facts.claim: Pest Control has 25 variables and each variable has 5 categories
Each benchmark variable has one domain shared by every point. In VGC the form fixes the ability list and the movepool, so one choice rewrites another slot's list of values
facts.source: notes/Teaching/reference/bo-benchmarks-vs-vgc-full-team-search-unit.md, Differences in the search unit, difference 4

facts.claim: Movepool range is 1 to 105, Ditto to Gallade, in the 2026-09-18 Showdown validator pull
facts.source: notes/Teaching/reference/bo-benchmarks-vs-vgc-full-team-search-unit.md, sizes table, Movepool range row, and difference 4, Checked 2026-09-28

candidates.sentence: A Pokemon team looks like Pest Control in another way too: its choices affect each other. On Pest Control a pesticide used often earlier in the chain gets cheaper and works less well further on. But no choice there is forbidden, and every pesticide works at every station. On a team no two Pokemon may hold the same item, and Charizardite Y turns Charizard into its Mega form while on Garchomp it is legal and does nothing.

facts.claim: In Pest Control the price and effectiveness of pesticides are adjusted depending on the previously made choices: frequent purchase earns a discount and frequent use builds pest tolerance
Pest Control has no built-in constraints, and in Pest Control every pesticide acts at every station
facts.source: notes/Teaching/reference/bo-benchmarks-vs-vgc-full-team-search-unit.md, The benchmarks table, Pest control row, and difference 12

facts.claim: Species Clause and Item Clause are all-different constraints across the six records, with no item exempt. No benchmark has an all-different constraint across separate records
facts.source: notes/Teaching/reference/bo-benchmarks-vs-vgc-full-team-search-unit.md, The VGC search unit paragraph and difference 9

facts.claim: A Mega Stone is legal on any Pokemon but only does anything on its own species. Charizardite Y on Garchomp is 'legal, does nothing'
